2608.30404.title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
2608.30404.paper_summary: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.
2608.30404.paper_summary_zh: 精確的冠狀血管腔體分割是定量評估冠狀計算機斷層血管造影 (CCTA) 中動脈粥樣硬化斑塊和血管周圍脂肪組織的前提。心臟病醫生依賴半自動化的方法來完成這項任務，因為手動血管描繪和分割非常耗費人力。儘管已提出許多自動化方法，但由於缺乏大型、高質量的公開數據集，其驗證仍然受到限制。我們提供了一個新的數據集，包含了來自公開可用的 ImageCAS 數據集的 800 次掃描的血管腔體和冠狀段的體素級註釋，並附有中心線和網格表面。使用這個數據集，我們將已建立的腔體分割方法與觀察者之間的變異性進行基準測試，並根據疾病、影像質量、冠狀優勢、冠狀段、血管直徑和腔體衰減來分層性能。這些標籤允許在解剖和臨床背景中描述分割準確性，而不是以單一的綜合分數報告。該數據集支持腔體分割、斑塊和血管周圍定量以及血流動力學建模方法的開發和驗證。
